sections.title: AI Services for Austin Healthcare Organizations

items.title: Clinical AI for Austin Health Systems
items.description: Ascension Seton (the largest health system in Central Texas with multiple hospitals and clinics), St. David's HealthCare (HCA Healthcare's Central Texas operations), Austin Regional Clinic, and the University of Texas Dell Medical School at UT Austin. Patient risk stratification: 30-day readmission, clinical deterioration, and chronic disease management risk models for Austin's health systems — with Epic FHIR integration. Clinical documentation AI: NLP reducing physician documentation burden — structured note generation, ICD-10 coding assistance, and prior authorization processing. Revenue cycle optimization: claim denial prediction and prevention, prior authorization automation, and coding optimization. Cost: $55,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | HIPAA + Epic FHIR standard.
items.label: Clinical AI

items.title: Digital Health Product AI (Austin's Fastest-Growing Segment)
items.description: Austin's technology culture and healthcare tech investment (supported by Austin's venture community and proximity to Houston's large healthcare market) is producing a growing number of digital health startups: remote patient monitoring AI for Austin's telehealth and chronic disease management startups; mental health and behavioral health AI — Austin's mental health startup community is active, building apps for therapy, crisis support, and behavioral health monitoring; health and wellness AI for Austin's consumer health and fitness technology companies; healthcare analytics SaaS for hospitals and health plans. Cost: $40,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks | HIPAA + FDA SaMD awareness.

sections.title: Texas Healthcare Regulatory Context
sections.description: ClickMasters builds healthcare AI with full awareness of Texas's regulatory framework.

items.title: HIPAA
items.description: BAA standard before any PHI access in all ClickMasters Austin healthcare AI engagements. Texas-specific HIPAA considerations — Texas Medical Records Privacy Act provides additional protections beyond HIPAA that ClickMasters designs with in mind.
items.label: HIPAA

items.title: Texas Medical Privacy Act
items.description: Texas imposes specific requirements on healthcare providers and health information organizations handling Texas patient data — ClickMasters designs Austin healthcare AI with Texas Medical Privacy Act awareness.
items.label: TX Medical Privacy

items.title: FDA SaMD
items.description: Austin's digital health community increasingly builds AI that may be classified as Software as a Medical Device — ClickMasters strongly recommends qualified FDA regulatory counsel for any Austin digital health AI that influences clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions.
items.label: FDA SaMD

items.title: UT Dell Medical School Context
items.description: Dell Medical School's innovative care model (part of Seton and the city of Austin's healthcare infrastructure investment) creates research AI opportunities — ClickMasters designs research AI with appropriate IRB and research data governance.
